summary: Pack entity is the field-meaning authority for CanonicalPack as CanonicalEntity pack PackBody, a studio-only reusable expression sprite pack with no format adapter, no toCanonical fromCanonical, and no formats matrix row. schema.ts owns the PackBody type; this page owns meanings. How to read the field table notes every Producers cell is dash because fields are studio-authored not wire-imported. Composition is a flat name brief pack and optional groups map with no eight-group CharacterBody layout. Pack body table covers library name shelf brief the main SpritePackValue pack and Lumi-style multi-character groups. The sprite pack hub shape defines SpritePackValue and SpritePackItem in core media pack.ts shared with character media.assets role emotion including resolvePackFace defaults. What rides escrow, not a field states packs never carry original escrow. See also links architecture character Media and formats matrix.

sections.title: How to read the field table
sections.summary: The field table is generated by scripts/docs-fields.ts and embedded verbatim; never hand-edit a cell, improve the schema doc comment and regenerate. Field is the canonical name with trailing question mark for optional. Type is the schema TypeScript type. Producers are always dash on this page because pack has no adapter and fields are studio-authored not carried from a wire format. Meaning explains purpose; blank meaning cells do not occur here. Richer explanation lives only in surrounding prose never inside a cell.

sections.title: Composition
sections.summary: PackBody stays flat with name optional shelf brief the pack SpritePackValue and optional groups map of named SpritePackValue entries. There are no always-present sub-objects like CharacterBody eight groups. pack and each groups entry share SpritePackValue the label-to-image hub that character media.assets role emotion also project through. SpritePackValue and SpritePackItem live in src/core/media/pack.ts not pack schema so docs-fields does not generate their table; prose covers them under The sprite pack hub shape. The body table comes from docs/generated/fields.pack.md.

sections.title: Pack body
sections.summary: PackBody fields: name is the library and tab name. brief is a short shelf card blurb never host wire. pack is the emotion pack as SpritePackValue label to image hub shared with character media. groups is optional Record string SpritePackValue for multi-character Lumi-style groups where the flat pack is the default group when groups is absent.

sections.title: The sprite pack hub shape
sections.summary: SpritePackValue in core media pack.ts is the label-to-image hub for character cards and library packs. items is SpritePackItem array of id label ref into asset store or data URI and optional mime. enabled is pack-wide on off. defaultLabel picks the resting face; resolvePackFace falls back to a face labelled neutral then the first item. packFromMedia and emotionAssetsFromPack convert character media.assets role emotion through this same shape. groups holds one full SpritePackValue per named member for multi-character scenes as Lumiverse expression_groups; absent groups means pack alone is the default group.

sections.title: What rides escrow, not a field
sections.summary: Pack is never a toCanonical fromCanonical target so it never carries a foreign source payload. Every save path PackEditor Workbench New pack and Save as library pack from Manage Sprites writes bare CanonicalEntity pack PackBody with no original entry; body is the whole record. Rides escrow nothing because there is no wire format and original never populates. Item refs are authored inline data URIs or asset store references not binary carriers beside fields like character PNG sourceMedia.

sections.title: See also
sections.summary: Related pages close the pack map. architecture.md covers the canonical model the adapter contract and escrow rules that packs never use. entities/character.md Media section documents the character-attached form of the same SpritePackValue hub shape. formats/README.md is the coverage matrix and notes pack has no listed adapter because it is studio-native only.
